title: BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents
authors_zh: Jason Wei, Zhiqing Sun, Spencer Papay, Scott McKinney, Jeffrey Han, Isa Fulford, Hyung Won Chung, Alex Tachard Passos, William Fedus, Amelia Glaese
paper_type_zh: 网页智能体基准与数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究实时网页智能体评测、答案级 judge、测试时计算与污染审计的读者
one_line: BrowseComp releases 1,266 obfuscated hard factual web questions and short answers scored by an answer-only LLM judge, but no browsing trajectories, citations, or replayable web state, and its current official reference scorer has a label-parsing defect.
BrowseComp 发布 1,266 道经可逆混淆的高难度网页事实问答题，以答案级 LLM judge 评分；它不发布浏览轨迹、引用或可回放网页状态，且当前官方参考 scorer 存在标签解析缺陷。
why: It is a canonical stress test for persistent live-web search and test-time compute, while its reversible anti-leakage layer, single-reference judge, undisclosed paper grader, post-release contamination risk, missing episodes, and scoring-code defect show why benchmark availability is not the same as trajectory reuse or reproducible feedback.
inclusion_reason: BrowseComp is a high-signal web-agent evaluation surface: it exposes 1,266 human-authored hard factual prompts, an explicit short-answer judge contract, construction filters, calibration and test-time-compute analyses, plus unusually important release risks. Its value to this track comes from separating an environment-interaction benchmark from a trajectory corpus and from making answer-only, live-web, contamination, and evaluator-reproducibility limits auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
BrowseComp asks how to evaluate browsing agents after common factual QA and retrieval benchmarks have become too easy for systems that can search the live web. OpenAI released the benchmark on 10 April 2025; the arXiv record, BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents (arXiv:2504.12516), was first submitted on 16 April 2025. The paper studies original BrowseComp only. BrowseComp-Plus and other later derivatives are separate records, and none of their corpus, evidence, citation, or replay properties is transferred here.

The benchmark contains 1,266 human-authored, hard-to-find factual questions with intended short, stable answers. A released row has exactly four fields: obfuscated problem, obfuscated answer, plaintext problem_topic, and plaintext canary. The official CSV contains 1,266 rows, not browser actions, queries, page observations, source URLs, citations, timestamps, confidence records, or successful and failed run logs. During evaluation, a model produces a free-form response with an Exact Answer and confidence, and an LLM judge compares that response with the single reference answer.

It belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because it measures agents that interact with the changing live web and because its missing environment contract is itself important to audit. It is not a released trajectory corpus, citation benchmark, replayable browser environment, or training recipe. The verified paper, appendix, OpenAI release page, official CSV, and simple-evals code support an L4 bilingual Card, while the undisclosed paper grader, absent run traces, unpinned web substrate, and current scorer defect keep the accepted metadata at L3_summary_ready and the reuse class at evaluation/audit only.

BrowseComp 研究的具体问题是：当常见事实问答和检索 benchmark 对可访问实时网页的系统已不够难时，如何评测浏览智能体。OpenAI 于 2025 年 4 月 10 日发布该 benchmark；arXiv 记录 BrowseComp: A Simple Yet Challenging Benchmark for Browsing Agents（arXiv:2504.12516）首次提交于 2025 年 4 月 16 日。本卡只讨论原版 BrowseComp。BrowseComp-Plus 和其他后续衍生工作是独立记录，其语料、证据、引用或回放属性均不得移植到本卡。

该 benchmark 含 1,266 道由人类编写、难以检索的事实问题，每题对应一个预期简短且稳定的答案。公开数据每行恰有四个字段：经混淆的 problem、经混淆的 answer、明文 problem_topic 与明文 canary。官方 CSV 有 1,266 行，但不包含浏览器动作、查询、页面 observation、来源 URL、引用、时间戳、置信度记录，也不包含成功或失败的运行日志。评测时，模型生成带 Exact Answer 与置信度的自由文本响应，再由 LLM judge 将响应与单一参考答案比较。

它归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为其评测对象是在变化中的实时网页上交互的智能体，而且缺失的环境契约本身就是关键审计对象。它不是已发布的轨迹语料、引用 benchmark、可回放浏览器环境或训练 recipe。已核验的论文、附录、OpenAI 发布页、官方 CSV 与 simple-evals 代码足以支撑 L4 双语 Card；但论文 grader 未披露、运行轨迹缺失、网页 substrate 未固定以及当前 scorer 缺陷，要求保留 accepted metadata 的 L3_summary_ready，复用等级仅为评测/审计。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
BrowseComp's contribution is to construct factual questions that are easy to verify once the answer is known but deliberately hard to locate, then score an agent's final answer rather than its browsing process. Human trainers begin from a person, event, or artifact, collect discriminating facts, and invert those facts into a question designed to resist ordinary search and contemporary models. This produces an answer-level evaluation surface for persistent information seeking, calibration, and test-time-compute studies.

The released data object is a question/reference-answer pair plus topic and canary metadata. In the CSV, the question and answer are Base64-encoded XOR ciphertext. The official decryptor derives a repeated key from SHA-256 of the row's public canary; because the canary/password and decryptor are released together, this is reversible leakage friction and canary-based filtering support, not cryptographic access control.

The feedback contract is judgment-required and answer-level. The judge receives the question, full model response, and gold answer; it extracts the proposed final answer, explains meaningful differences, permits a small margin for numerical answers, and is instructed to emit correct: yes or correct: no. It can assess semantic answer agreement under its prompt, but it cannot observe whether browsing occurred, whether retrieved evidence was factual, whether citations support the answer, whether the path was efficient or reproducible, or why the agent failed. Confidence supports calibration and parallel selection analysis, not process supervision.

Relative to fixed-corpus retrieval and browser-environment benchmarks, BrowseComp deliberately leaves the web and agent scaffold model-specific while keeping the terminal label simple. Relative to SimpleQA and Humanity's Last Exam, its distinctive object is a human-inverted question constructed to require persistent browsing. BrowseComp-Plus is a later, separate related record; its fixed corpus and evidence annotations are not properties of original BrowseComp.

BrowseComp 的贡献是构造“知道答案后容易核验、但答案刻意难以找到”的事实问题，并只评分智能体的最终答案，而不评分浏览过程。人类 trainer 从人物、事件或 artifact 出发，收集有区分力的事实，再把这些事实反向改写为旨在抵抗普通搜索和当代模型的问题。由此得到一个面向持续信息检索、校准和测试时计算研究的答案级评测表面。

公开数据对象是问题—参考答案对，以及 topic 和 canary metadata。在 CSV 中，问题与答案是 Base64 编码的 XOR 密文。官方 decryptor 使用每行公开 canary 的 SHA-256 派生重复密钥；由于 canary/password 与 decryptor 同时公开，这一设计只是可逆的泄漏阻力和基于 canary 的过滤辅助，而不是密码学访问控制。

反馈契约是 judgment-required、answer-level。judge 接收问题、模型完整响应和 gold answer，抽取候选最终答案，解释有意义的差异，对数值答案允许小幅误差，并按指令输出 correct: yes 或 correct: no。它可以在给定 prompt 下判断答案语义是否一致，但无法观察智能体是否实际浏览、检索证据是否真实、引用是否支持答案、路径是否高效或可复现，也无法解释智能体为何失败。置信度只用于校准和并行选择分析，不构成过程监督。

相较于固定语料检索和浏览器环境 benchmark，BrowseComp 刻意让网页与 agent scaffold 保持模型特定，同时把终点标签保持为简单答案判断。相较于 SimpleQA 与 Humanity's Last Exam，其特定对象是为迫使持续浏览而由人类反向构造的问题。BrowseComp-Plus 是后续的独立相关记录；其固定语料和证据标注不属于原版 BrowseComp。

title: Method
方法
html:
The construction input is a human-selected factual seed such as a person, event, or artifact. A trainer gathers distinguishing characteristics and supporting evidence, then inverts them into a fact-seeking question intended to have one indisputable, short answer that should not change over time. Trainers were encouraged to use personal interests. Record-level seeds, evidence URLs, passages, timestamps, writer/validator identifiers, and upstream rights are not released.

Candidate filtering combines three difficulty checks. First, GPT-4o with and without browsing, o1, and an early Deep Research version are expected to fail. Second, the trainer performs five simple Google searches and requires the answer not to be readily visible on the first result pages. Third, the intended target is that another person cannot solve the item within ten minutes, but this check was not strictly enforced and only a portion received second-trainer attempts. If a trainer's questions were solved above 40%, the items were revised. A prompted OpenAI chat-model classifier assigns one of ten topics after construction; its prompt, checkpoint, and confidence are unknown.

The initial pool contained 1,287 tasks. Among 118 tasks on which Deep Research had a 0% pass rate, manual review removed 21 because of answer-format mismatch, ambiguity, or incorrect reasoning, leaving 1,266. This review improves some labels but also conditions the final set on an undisclosed Deep Research revision. Removed rows, item-level filter outcomes, alternative-answer adjudication, and a canonical train/dev/hidden split are not released.

For use, the official evaluator downloads the four-column CSV and decrypts problem and answer with the public canary-derived XOR routine. It prompts the evaluated system for an explanation, a succinct Exact Answer, and 0%-100% confidence. A separate LLM grader sees question, response, and reference answer and should return a binary semantic-match judgment. The paper and release page do not disclose the grader checkpoint used for the reported results. The current repository runner supplies gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, but that later configuration is not evidence for the paper's grader.

At inspected commit 652c89d0ca9df547706735883097e9537d40dc47, current browsecomp_eval.py has a blocking reference-scorer defect: grade_sample returns match.group(0), such as correct: yes or correct: no, while the caller compares the returned value with bare yes and no. Matched outputs therefore set neither boolean flag. A reproducer must return the captured yes/no group and add expected-output tests before trusting scores from this code path. This is a static finding about the current reference implementation; it does not by itself show that the paper's separately generated results are invalid.

The output is an aggregate evaluation over answer correctness, model-reported confidence, and optional repeated samples. No SFT, RLVR, reward-model, or agent-policy training recipe is defined. Reproduction requires pinning the CSV checksum, repository commit, corrected scorer, grader checkpoint and settings, evaluated model revision, browsing/search stack, locale/session state, run date, and tool/token/page/time budgets; most of the latter fields remain unknown.

构造输入是由人类选择的事实种子，例如人物、事件或 artifact。trainer 收集有区分力的特征和支持证据，再把它们反向改写为事实检索问题；该问题应有一个无争议、简短且不会随时间变化的答案。trainer 被鼓励围绕个人兴趣出题。公开发布不含记录级种子、证据 URL、证据段落、时间戳、作者/验证者身份和上游权利信息。

候选过滤结合三类难度检查。第一，要求 GPT-4o（含浏览与不含浏览）、o1 和早期 Deep Research 版本无法解题。第二，trainer 进行五次简单 Google 搜索，要求答案不会直接出现在首批结果页面。第三，目标是另一人无法在十分钟内解题，但该检查没有严格执行，且只有部分题目接受第二位 trainer 尝试。如果某位 trainer 的题目解出率高于 40%，相关题目会被修订。构造完成后，由受提示词驱动的 OpenAI chat-model classifier 分配十个 topic 之一；其 prompt、checkpoint 和置信度均为 unknown。

初始候选池有 1,287 道题。Deep Research 通过率为 0% 的题目共有 118 道，其中 21 道经人工复查后因答案格式不匹配、歧义或推理错误而删除，最终留下 1,266 道。这一复查改善了部分标签，但也让最终集合受一个未披露 Deep Research 版本的表现条件化。被删记录、逐题过滤结果、替代答案裁决以及 canonical train/dev/hidden split 均未发布。

使用时，官方 evaluator 下载四列 CSV，并用公开 canary 派生的 XOR 例程解密 problem 与 answer。它要求被测系统输出解释、简洁的 Exact Answer 和 0%-100% 置信度。另一个 LLM grader 读取问题、响应和参考答案，应返回二元语义匹配判断。论文与发布页没有披露论文结果所用 grader checkpoint。当前仓库 runner 指定 gpt-4.1-2025-04-14，但这个后来的配置不能作为论文 grader 的证据。

在已检查 commit 652c89d0ca9df547706735883097e9537d40dc47 中，当前 browsecomp_eval.py 存在阻塞 reference scorer 的缺陷：grade_sample 返回 match.group(0)，即 correct: yes 或 correct: no；调用方却将返回值与裸 yes、no 比较。因此，匹配成功的输出也不会把任一布尔标志设为 true。复现者必须改为返回捕获的 yes/no 分组并添加期望输出测试，之后才能信任该代码路径得到的分数。这是对当前参考实现的静态发现；它本身并不证明论文通过另一评测过程产生的结果无效。

输出是针对答案正确性、模型自报置信度及可选重复采样的聚合评测。论文没有定义 SFT、RLVR、reward-model 或 agent-policy 训练 recipe。复现需要固定 CSV checksum、仓库 commit、修正后的 scorer、grader checkpoint 与设置、被测模型版本、浏览/搜索栈、locale/session state、运行日期以及工具/token/页面/时间预算；其中后半部分大多仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The human verification campaign attempted 1,255 of 1,266 questions; 11 were not attempted. Solvers came from the trainer pool, could not answer their own questions, did not receive the gold answer, and were instructed not to use named AI assistants. After about two hours, 888 gave up and 367 reported a solution; 317 of those 367 solutions matched the reference. These counts support the claim that the set is difficult for the tested humans and that most reported solutions agree with the reference. They do not provide released human search trajectories or prove that every single reference answer is exhaustive.

Table 3 reports accuracy/calibration error in percent under named model versions: GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-08-06) 0.6/69; GPT-4o with browsing (gpt-4o-search-preview-2025-03-11) 1.9/82; GPT-4.5 (gpt-4.5-preview-2025-02-27) 0.9/68; o1 (o1-2024-12-17, medium) 9.9/65; and Deep Research 51.5/91. The Deep Research revision is not disclosed. The high calibration errors for browsing-capable systems support the authors' warning that they can be confidently wrong, but the paper text inspected does not specify the exact calibration-error formula.

Figure 1 and Section 4.3 report that Deep Research accuracy rises smoothly across runs with different browsing effort, without disclosing the effort unit, token/tool/page budget, latency, cost, or exact checkpoint. Sections 4.4-4.5 generate 64 outputs or trials per question: majority vote, confidence-weighted vote, and best-of-N all improve over one attempt by 15%-25%, with best-of-N highest. The wording does not unambiguously distinguish relative percent from percentage points. Across 64 Deep Research trials per item, 16% of tasks have 100% pass rate and 14% have 0% pass rate. For most zero-pass items, revealing the answer lets Deep Research find supporting web evidence, but “most” is not quantified and those runs are not released.

The official CSV inspected on 20 July 2026 has 1,266 rows and four columns, is 1,196,283 bytes, and has SHA-256 7B24471CD5B3EB2A46830A14802B5C029EA62F488FF75A0F88AF7923D1454ABF. All four fields are non-empty, and official decryption succeeds for every question and answer without reproducing their plaintext here. The official repository and dataset therefore establish artifact availability and schema, not independent answer fact-checking, trajectory quality, or grader validity.

All performance numbers above are author-reported and were not independently reproduced for this Card. The current reference scorer defect prevents a direct reproduction from the inspected main branch until it is repaired and tested. That implementation finding narrows the reproducibility claim; it is not a blanket claim that the paper's results are invalid.

人类验证活动尝试了 1,266 道题中的 1,255 道，另有 11 道未尝试。解题者来自 trainer pool，不能回答自己编写的问题，不会看到 gold answer，并被要求不得使用指定的 AI assistant。约两小时后，888 人放弃，367 人报告解答；这 367 份解答中有 317 份与参考答案一致。这些计数支持“该集合对被测人类较难”以及“大多数已报告解答与参考答案一致”，但不提供公开的人类搜索轨迹，也不能证明每个单一参考答案都穷尽所有有效答案。

Table 3 在指定模型版本下报告准确率/校准误差（百分比）：GPT-4o（gpt-4o-2024-08-06）为 0.6/69；带浏览的 GPT-4o（gpt-4o-search-preview-2025-03-11）为 1.9/82；GPT-4.5（gpt-4.5-preview-2025-02-27）为 0.9/68；o1（o1-2024-12-17，medium）为 9.9/65；Deep Research 为 51.5/91。Deep Research 的具体 revision 未披露。浏览系统的高校准误差支持作者关于“可能自信地答错”的提醒，但已检查的论文正文没有给出校准误差的精确公式。

Figure 1 与 Section 4.3 报告 Deep Research 准确率随不同 browsing effort 平滑上升，但没有披露 effort 单位、token/工具/页面预算、延迟、成本或精确 checkpoint。Sections 4.4-4.5 对每题生成 64 个输出或 trial：majority vote、confidence-weighted vote 与 best-of-N 相对单次尝试均提升 15%-25%，best-of-N 最高。论文措辞没有明确说明该幅度是相对百分比还是百分点。在每题 64 次 Deep Research trial 下，16% 题目的通过率为 100%，14% 为 0%。对大多数零通过率题目，先透露答案可让 Deep Research 找到支持网页证据；但 “most” 没有具体数值，这些运行也未发布。

2026 年 7 月 20 日检查的官方 CSV 有 1,266 行、四列，大小为 1,196,283 bytes，SHA-256 为 7B24471CD5B3EB2A46830A14802B5C029EA62F488FF75A0F88AF7923D1454ABF。四个字段均非空，使用官方解密方法可成功解密每个问题和答案，本卡不复现其明文。因此，官方仓库与数据集证明的是 artifact 可用性和 schema，而不是对答案逐条独立事实核验、轨迹质量或 grader 有效性的证明。

上述性能数字均为作者报告，本卡未独立复现。当前 reference scorer 的缺陷使已检查 main branch 在修复并测试前不能直接用于复现。该实现发现收窄的是可复现性主张，并不是笼统宣称论文结果无效。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior browsing benchmarks often use relatively direct questions, fixed retrieval corpora, navigation goals, or environment-specific terminal predicates. SimpleQA supplies short factual QA, and Humanity's Last Exam supplies the query and grader prompt pattern referenced by the released harness. BrowseComp changes the task construction: human trainers begin from an answer-bearing factual seed, collect multiple discriminating attributes, invert them into a question, and then deliberately filter for failure by models, ordinary Google search, and selected humans.

The resulting object couples 1,266 public answer targets with a live-web challenge, calibration prompt, LLM answer judge, and repeated-sampling analysis. This makes persistent search difficulty, answer-level uncertainty, and test-time-compute returns observable without requiring a single standardized browser implementation. Its strongest direction signal for reasoning-data research is the explicit separation between the public task/answer table and the private or model-specific search process.

What is not new is short-answer QA, LLM-as-a-judge scoring, confidence elicitation, repeated sampling, majority voting, best-of-N, or web search individually. The work also does not introduce a replayable environment, evidence/citation score, browser-action schema, or open trajectory dataset. The 1,266-row scale and performance tables are not themselves evidence of data quality.

Before reuse, inspect the single-answer adjudication, paper grader identity, current scorer repair, live-web version drift, canary handling, contamination exposure, dataset-specific rights, and absence of success/failure traces. Read BrowseComp-Plus only as a later separate record: its fixed corpus, qrels, and evidence documents must not be attributed to original BrowseComp.

既有浏览 benchmark 常采用较直接的问题、固定检索语料、导航目标或环境特定 terminal predicate。SimpleQA 提供简短事实问答，Humanity's Last Exam 则提供公开 harness 所沿用的 query 与 grader prompt 形式。BrowseComp 改变的是任务构造：人类 trainer 从带答案的事实种子出发，收集多个有区分力的属性，将其反向写成问题，再刻意筛选出模型、普通 Google 搜索和部分人类无法解决的题目。

最终对象把 1,266 个公开答案目标与实时网页挑战、校准 prompt、LLM answer judge 和重复采样分析结合起来。它不要求统一浏览器实现，也能观察持续搜索难度、答案级不确定性和测试时计算回报。对 reasoning-data 研究最有方向价值的，是它明确区分公开任务/答案表与私有或模型特定的搜索过程。

简答式 QA、LLM-as-a-judge 评分、置信度诱导、重复采样、majority voting、best-of-N 或网页搜索本身都不是新组件。该工作也没有提出可回放环境、证据/引用评分、浏览器动作 schema 或公开轨迹数据集。1,266 行规模和性能表本身不能作为数据质量证据。

复用前应检查单一答案裁决、论文 grader 身份、当前 scorer 修复、实时网页版本漂移、canary 处理、污染暴露、数据集特定权利以及成功/失败轨迹缺失。BrowseComp-Plus 只能作为后续的独立记录阅读；其固定语料、qrels 和证据文档不得归因于原版 BrowseComp。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The answer contract can produce false negatives. Inverted questions establish that the supplied reference is valid more readily than they establish that all valid answers are known. Trainers add constraints and revise items when another person finds a different valid answer, but the paper explicitly does not guarantee uniqueness. A single-reference LLM judge can still reject an alternative answer, and the paper does not disclose its grader checkpoint, decoding settings, validation set, calibration, or sensitivity analysis.

The current browsecomp_eval.py scorer is blocked by a concrete label-handling mismatch: it returns correct: yes/no but compares with yes/no. No BrowseComp unit test catches the defect, and the repository has no tagged evaluator release or dependency lock. The current runner's gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 grader postdates the OpenAI release and cannot be assumed to match the paper grader. These facts block direct reproduction from the current reference code; they do not prove that the paper results, produced through an undisclosed evaluation path, are invalid.

The released object omits the process that the benchmark is meant to stress. There are no model responses, confidence records, queries, tool calls, page observations, URLs, citations, screenshots, timestamps, retries, success paths, failure paths, or grader transcripts from the reported experiments. The live web, search rankings, access policies, commercial products, and page contents drift, while no web snapshot, browser image, reset state, locale, timeout, or deterministic replay fixture is supplied. The answer-only judge cannot assess citation support, source quality, browsing faithfulness, persistence, or process efficiency.

The anti-contamination layer is limited. Question and answer plaintext are reversibly obfuscated, but the public canary/password and official decryptor recover them. The canary GUID and request not to repost examples may aid filtering if honored; no post-release exposure measurement, training-corpus overlap scan, refreshed or hidden holdout, or removal guarantee is reported. Public release therefore creates continuing contamination risk.

Construction and release metadata also remain incomplete. Review removed 21 of 118 Deep Research zero-pass items, conditioning the final set on an undisclosed model version while withholding removed rows and reasons. Record-level factual sources, evidence, trainer/validator identities, dates, adjudication, and upstream rights are absent. The repository is MIT-licensed and labels BrowseComp accordingly, but the separately hosted CSV has no embedded data license or data card; this does not establish rights to all underlying web facts. Trainer count, demographics, compensation, consent, PII review, ethics review, and privacy policy are unknown.

Finally, Deep Research was trained on data intended to teach BrowseComp-like task skill. That disclosure does not establish use of the released 1,266 rows, but exact training overlap is unknown. Main-evaluation retry policies and budgets are unknown, and the reported test-time-compute curve lacks units. These gaps constrain attribution across model capability, browsing scaffold, grader, data construction, and extra inference compute.

答案契约可能产生 false negative。反向构造问题更容易保证“给出的参考答案有效”，而不容易保证“所有有效答案都已被枚举”。trainer 会添加约束，并在他人找到另一个有效答案时修订题目，但论文明确不保证唯一性。单一参考答案的 LLM judge 仍可能拒绝替代答案；论文也未披露 grader checkpoint、解码设置、验证集、校准或敏感性分析。

当前 browsecomp_eval.py scorer 被一个具体标签处理错配阻塞：它返回 correct: yes/no，却与 yes/no 比较。仓库没有 BrowseComp unit test 捕获该缺陷，也没有 tagged evaluator release 或 dependency lock。当前 runner 的 gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 grader 晚于 OpenAI 发布日期，不能假设等同于论文 grader。这些事实阻塞从当前参考代码直接复现；它们并不证明通过未披露评测路径得到的论文结果无效。

公开对象省略了 benchmark 试图施压的过程。论文实验中的模型响应、置信度记录、查询、工具调用、页面 observation、URL、引用、截图、时间戳、重试、成功路径、失败路径和 grader transcript 都没有发布。实时网页、搜索排名、访问政策、商业产品和页面内容会漂移，而发布不含网页 snapshot、浏览器 image、reset state、locale、timeout 或确定性回放 fixture。答案级 judge 无法评估引用支持、来源质量、浏览忠实度、持续性或过程效率。

反污染层能力有限。问题和答案明文经过可逆混淆，但公开 canary/password 与官方 decryptor 可以恢复它们。canary GUID 与“不转载样例”的请求在被遵守时可辅助过滤；论文没有报告发布后暴露度测量、训练语料重叠扫描、刷新版或隐藏 holdout，也没有移除保证。因此，公开发布会带来持续污染风险。

构造与发布 metadata 也不完整。对 118 道 Deep Research 零通过率题目复查后删除 21 道，使最终集合受一个未披露模型版本条件化，同时被删记录和原因没有发布。记录级事实来源、证据、trainer/validator 身份、日期、裁决和上游权利均缺失。仓库采用 MIT license 并据此标注 BrowseComp，但单独托管的 CSV 没有内嵌 data license 或 data card；这不能确立所有底层网页事实的权利。trainer 数量、人口统计、补偿、同意、PII 审查、伦理审查和隐私政策均为 unknown。

最后，Deep Research 曾用旨在教授 BrowseComp 类任务能力的数据训练。该披露不能证明公开的 1,266 行被用于训练，但确切训练重叠为 unknown。主评测的重试策略和预算为 unknown，测试时计算曲线也没有给出单位。这些缺口限制了在模型能力、浏览 scaffold、grader、数据构造和额外推理计算之间进行归因。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, BrowseComp is most useful as a boundary case: the task requires environment interaction, but the release serializes only question, answer, topic, and canary. A track audit can use it to test whether a Card incorrectly promotes an agent benchmark into a trajectory dataset. Any replayable episode schema built around BrowseComp would need to add query/action/observation records, URLs and captures, tool and model revisions, budgets, stopping reasons, confidence, grader transcript, and successful and failed paths; those are not supplied by the benchmark.

The supported reuse classes are evaluation, audit, and test-time-compute analysis. For evaluation, decrypt the official CSV with the shipped routine, repair and test the label parser, pin a grader and its prompt/settings, pin the agent and search stack, record the live-web date and budget, and report both accuracy and confidence behavior. For audit, measure alternative-answer sensitivity, judge drift, current scorer correctness, canary exposure, train/test overlap, and web drift. For test-time compute, compare equal-budget repeated sampling and state the unit of compute; the paper's 64-sample analysis is a reference design, not a released rollout set.

The release is not established as safe for SFT, distillation, reward modeling, RLVR, or agent-policy training. Public questions and answers are a test set, the post-release contamination status is unknown, and no reusable trajectory or process reward is published. Treat it as evaluation/audit reference material subject to scorer repair and environment pinning, not as training-ready data. Benchmark performance should be used to compare evaluated systems under stated conditions, never as a substitute for validating the questions, reference answers, judge, rights, or lineage.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 轨道而言，BrowseComp 最有用之处是作为一个边界案例：任务需要环境交互，但发布只序列化问题、答案、topic 和 canary。轨道审计可以用它检查 Card 是否错误地把 agent benchmark 提升为轨迹数据集。若围绕 BrowseComp 构建可回放 episode schema，必须另行增加查询/action/observation 记录、URL 与页面捕获、工具和模型 revision、预算、停止原因、置信度、grader transcript，以及成功与失败路径；benchmark 本身没有提供这些字段。

有证据支持的复用类别只有 evaluation、audit 和 test-time-compute analysis。用于评测时，应使用官方例程解密 CSV，修复并测试标签 parser，固定 grader 及其 prompt/设置，固定 agent 与搜索栈，并记录实时网页日期和预算，同时报告准确率与置信度行为。用于审计时，应测量替代答案敏感性、judge 漂移、当前 scorer 正确性、canary 暴露、训练/测试重叠和网页漂移。用于测试时计算时，应在等预算下比较重复采样并明确计算单位；论文的 64 样本分析是参考设计，不是已发布 rollout set。

该发布没有被证明可安全用于 SFT、distillation、reward modeling、RLVR 或 agent-policy training。公开问题与答案属于测试集，发布后的污染状态为 unknown，且没有公开可复用轨迹或过程奖励。应把它视为需要先修复 scorer 并固定环境的评测/审计参考，而不是 training-ready data。Benchmark 性能只能用于比较给定条件下的被测系统，不能代替对问题、参考答案、judge、权利或 lineage 的验证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The public release is one 1,266-row, four-column test CSV: obfuscated problem and answer, plus plaintext problem_topic and canary; the canary and XOR decryptor are public, so obfuscation is reversible.
  • BrowseComp scores semantic agreement with one reference answer. The paper grader checkpoint is unknown, and the judge cannot verify searches, evidence, citations, or browsing trajectories.
  • The current official browsecomp_eval.py returns correct: yes/no but compares with bare yes/no; repair and test this reference scorer before using it, without treating the bug as proof that the paper results are invalid.
  • Table 3 and the 64-sample analyses show difficulty, overconfidence, and test-time-compute effects under reported systems; they do not prove dataset quality or release completeness.
  • Read with the live-web and contamination limits in view: no replay substrate or run traces are released, public decryption enables leakage, and supported use remains evaluation, audit, and test-time-compute analysis.

• 公开发布是一个 1,266 行、四列的测试 CSV：经混淆的 problem 与 answer，以及明文 problem_topic 和 canary；canary 与 XOR decryptor 都是公开的，因此混淆可逆。
  • BrowseComp 评分的是与单一参考答案的语义一致性。论文 grader checkpoint 为 unknown，judge 无法验证搜索、证据、引用或浏览轨迹。
  • 当前官方 browsecomp_eval.py 返回 correct: yes/no，却与裸 yes/no 比较；使用前必须修复并测试这个 reference scorer，但不能把该缺陷当作论文结果无效的证明。
  • Table 3 与 64 样本分析展示了已报告系统下的难度、过度自信和测试时计算效应；它们不能证明数据集质量或发布完整性。
  • 阅读时必须同时考虑实时网页与污染边界：没有发布 replay substrate 或运行轨迹，公开解密使泄漏成为可能，有证据支持的用途仍只有 evaluation、audit 和 test-time-compute analysis。

value.html: A 1,266-item live-web browsing benchmark. Each released row contains an obfuscated factual question, an obfuscated short reference answer, one plaintext topic label, and a plaintext canary/password. An evaluated run adds a prompted free-form response and an answer-level LLM judgment; it does not add a canonical browser trajectory to the released dataset.

value_zh.html: 含 1,266 条的实时网页浏览基准。每个已发布行含一条混淆的事实问题、一条混淆的简短标准答案、一个明文主题标签与一个明文 canary/password。评测运行会添加提示的自由形式响应与答案级 LLM 判断；它不向已发布数据集添加规范浏览器轨迹。

value.html: Human trainers start from a factual seed such as a person, event, or artifact, collect discriminating characteristics, and invert them into a hard-to-find question with one intended short, stable answer. Trainers were encouraged to write about personal interests.

value_zh.html: 人类训练者从人物、事件或人工制品等事实种子出发，收集区分性特征，并将其反转为难以查找、且有一个预期简短稳定答案的问题。鼓励训练者撰写个人兴趣相关内容。

value.html: The benchmark itself provides no observation stream. Agents use the changing live web through their own browsing/search interfaces; page contents, URLs, search results, screenshots, timestamps, locale, account/session state, and browser state are not included in the official data.

value_zh.html: 基准本身不提供观察流。智能体通过自身浏览/搜索接口使用变化中的实时网页；页面内容、URLs、搜索结果、截图、时间戳、locale、账户/会话状态与浏览器状态均未包含在官方数据中。

value.html: The evaluated model is prompted to emit an explanation, one succinct Exact Answer, and a 0%-100% confidence. The reference answer is a short string; the released grader asks whether the extracted answer semantically matches it and allows a small numerical margin.

value.html: Evaluated browsing agents produce their own searches and interactions through model-specific live-web products, but the official release does not publish those action/observation traces. Construction evidence and human search traces are also not released.

value.html: One public 1,266-row test set is released; no train/dev/hidden split is defined. The evaluator can randomly sample a debugging subset with seed 0, but that is not a canonical benchmark split.

value.html: Collection instructions follow SimpleQA and query/grader prompts follow Humanity's Last Exam. The paper compares prior retrieval/web-agent benchmarks but reports no exact or semantic overlap audit with SimpleQA, HLE, other benchmarks, public question banks, or evaluated-model training data.

value_zh.html: 收集说明遵循 SimpleQA，查询/评分器提示遵循 Humanity's Last Exam。论文比较了先前检索/网页智能体基准，但未报告与 SimpleQA、HLE、其他基准、公开题库或被评测模型训练数据的精确或语义重叠审计。

value.html: The release obfuscates question/answer plaintext, includes a canary, and asks users not to post examples. Because the canary/password and decryptor are public, this is leakage friction and a filtering aid rather than access control. No training-corpus overlap scan, post-release contamination measurement, refreshed/hidden holdout, record-level contamination flag, or removal guarantee is reported.

value_zh.html: 发布混淆问题/答案明文，包含 canary，并要求用户不要发布示例。由于 canary/password 与解密器公开，这是泄漏摩擦与过滤辅助，而非访问控制。未报告训练语料重叠扫描、发布后污染测量、刷新/隐藏留出、记录级污染标志或移除保证。

value.html: The paper retains aggregate human give-up/solve counts, model accuracy/calibration, test-time-compute curves, and pass-rate distributions. The official release retains no per-run model response, confidence, successful path, failed path, query, tool call, page observation, citation, timestamp, retry, or grader transcript from the paper evaluations.

value_zh.html: 论文保留聚合的人类放弃/解答计数、模型准确率/校准、测试时计算曲线与通过率分布。官方发布不保留论文评测中的逐次运行模型响应、置信度、成功路径、失败路径、查询、工具调用、页面观察、引用、时间戳、重试或评分器转录。

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: Single-reference semantic judgment can reject another valid answer; the paper explicitly says inverted construction cannot guarantee that all valid answers are known.
The answer-only grader cannot verify browsing, factual evidence, source quality, citations, persistence, creativity, or a faithful search path.
The grader checkpoint used for paper results is undisclosed, so judge drift and judge-model sensitivity cannot be reproduced or audited.

Current browsecomp_eval.py returns strings such as correct: yes but compares them with bare yes/no, so matched judge outputs are not counted as correct or incorrect. No BrowseComp unit test catches this.

Twenty-one items were removed after reviewing Deep Research zero-pass cases; this improves labels but conditions the final benchmark on one undisclosed model version and does not expose removed records or adjudication.
Browsing-capable systems show high calibration error in Table 3, including 82% for GPT-4o with browsing and 91% for Deep Research, indicating overconfident wrong answers.
Live-web pages, rankings, access policies, and search results change; without snapshots or replay metadata, identical agent behavior may receive different information later.
Public obfuscation is reversible with the shipped canary and decryptor; after release, plaintext can enter training or online indexes despite the authors' request.
单参考语义判断可能拒绝另一个有效答案；论文明确指出反转构造不能保证所有有效答案已知。
仅答案评分器无法核验浏览、事实证据、来源质量、引用、持续性、创造性或忠实搜索路径。
用于论文结果的评分器检查点未披露，因此评审漂移与评审模型敏感性无法复现或审计。
当前 browsecomp_eval.py 返回诸如 correct: yes 的字符串，但用裸 yes/no 比较，因此匹配的评审模型输出不被计为正确或错误。无 BrowseComp 单元测试捕获此问题。
在审阅 Deep Research 零通过案例后移除了二十一个条目；这改善了标签，但使最终基准以一个未披露的模型版本为条件，且不公开被移除记录或裁决。
具备浏览能力的系统在表 3 中显示高校准误差，包括 82%（带浏览的 GPT-4o）与 91%（Deep Research），表明对错误答案过度自信。
实时网页、排名、访问策略与搜索结果会变化；若无快照或回放元数据，相同智能体行为稍后可能收到不同信息。
公开混淆可用随附的 canary 与解密器逆转；发布后，尽管作者有请求，明文仍可能进入训练或在线索引。

value.html: The paper says human trainers created the dataset and later attempted questions without named AI assistants. Trainer count, demographics, compensation, consent, privacy/PII screening, ethics or IRB review, rejected-work policy, and rights for person-related public-web facts are not disclosed.

value.html: The official simple-evals README lists BrowseComp with the repository MIT License, and the repository LICENSE is MIT. The separately hosted CSV contains no embedded license/data card, and the release does not document record-level upstream web-content rights; treat code/repository licensing as verified while retaining source-rights uncertainty.
